title: 교육감 소속 지방공무원 인사교류 규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:4:0:00004:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 4 (Meetings)
(1) The Council shall hold at least one meeting every year, to be convened and presided over by the chairperson upon request by the Minister of Education or where deemed necessary by the chairperson. <Amended on March 23, 2013>
(2) A superintendent of education may request the chairperson to convene a Council meeting to deliberate on matters concerning the development of the personnel exchange system.
(3) Where the chairperson is unable to perform duties for unavoidable reasons, the vice-chairperson shall act on the chairperson's behalf; where both are unable to perform duties, a member designated in advance by the chairperson shall act on the chairperson's behalf.
(4) A Council meeting shall open with the attendance of a majority of its incumbent members and adopt resolutions with the affirmative vote of a majority of the members present.
